note: No Antiquaries' Great Plan rings: the Society never excavated outside the walls here (C&F 2016, 220). Geometry: GIS layer 04_Background_Town_Wall_and_Amphitheatre, records 14 and 15, 'the stone phase of the Amphitheatre' (arena wall, entrance passages, recesses). Banks: the underlays below, fitted to that wall by chamfer matching.
scope: User 2026-10-13: stone phase (with Fulford's Stone Phase 2 floor raising); arena, passages, recesses, seating banks out to their toe; sunken arena (floor 2 m below the ground).
